notes.title: Music update!
notes.notes:
[b][i]Let the notes guide you![/i][/b]

Since many of you don't like the silence I've added some tunes during the gameplay.
Make sure to leave your feedback!
If you want your song in Ink. or just want to send me some song you like, please hit me at [url=https://twitter.com/cla8194]Twitter[/url].
